name: com.logiccuteguy.digholeit
description: Digger-style diggable terrain. Bakes Dig Zones over Unity Terrain into a quantized SDF grid and meshes it with Surface Nets. Dig, add and paint terrain layers at runtime or with Terrain-style brushes in the editor. Ships a VRChat (UdonSharp) runtime with networked edits and late-joiner replay, plus a plain C# runtime for standalone games.
